verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.pt: Então respondeu Bildade, o suíta:
verses.en_web: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
verses.en_bbe: Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

verses.en: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.pt: Até quando estareis à procura de palavras? considerai bem, e então falaremos.
verses.en_web: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.en_bbe: How long will it be before you have done talking? Get wisdom, and then we will say what is in our minds.

verses.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
verses.pt: Por que somos tratados como gado, e como estultos aos vossos olhos?
verses.en_web: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
verses.en_bbe: Why do we seem as beasts in your eyes, and as completely without knowledge?

verses.en: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
verses.pt: Oh tu, que te despedaças na tua ira, acaso por amor de ti será abandonada a terra, ou será a rocha removida do seu lugar?
verses.en_web: You who tear yourself in your anger, shall the earth be forsaken for you? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?
verses.en_bbe: But come back, now, come: you who are wounding yourself in your passion, will the earth be given up because of you, or a rock be moved out of its place?

verses.en: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.pt: Na verdade, a luz do ímpio se apagará, e não resplandecerá a chama do seu fogo.
verses.en_web: “Yes, the light of the wicked shall be put out, The spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.en_bbe: For the light of the sinner is put out, and the flame of his fire is not shining.

verses.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
verses.pt: A luz se escurecerá na sua tenda, e a lâmpada que está sobre ele se apagará.
verses.en_web: The light shall be dark in his tent. His lamp above him shall be put out.
verses.en_bbe: The light is dark in his tent, and the light shining over him is put out.

verses.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.pt: Os seus passos firmes se estreitarão, e o seu próprio conselho o derribará.
verses.en_web: The steps of his strength shall be shortened. His own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.en_bbe: The steps of his strength become short, and by his design destruction overtakes him.

verses.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
verses.pt: Pois por seus próprios pés é ele lançado na rede, e pisa nos laços armados.
verses.en_web: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
verses.en_bbe: His feet take him into the net, and he goes walking into the cords.

verses.en: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.pt: A armadilha o apanha pelo calcanhar, e o laço o prende;
verses.en_web: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
verses.en_bbe: His foot is taken in the net; he comes into its grip.

verses.en: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
verses.pt: a corda do mesmo está-lhe escondida na terra, e uma armadilha na vereda.
verses.en_web: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
verses.en_bbe: The twisted cord is put secretly in the earth to take him, and the cord is placed in his way.

verses.en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
verses.pt: Terrores o amedrontam de todos os lados, e de perto lhe perseguem os pés.
verses.en_web: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall chase him at his heels.
verses.en_bbe: He is overcome by fears on every side, they go after him at every step.

verses.en: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
verses.pt: O seu vigor é diminuído pela fome, e a destruição está pronta ao seu lado.
verses.en_web: His strength shall be famished. Calamity shall be ready at his side.
verses.en_bbe: His strength is made feeble for need of food, and destruction is waiting for his falling footstep.

verses.en: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
verses.pt: São devorados os membros do seu corpo; sim, o primogênito da morte devora os seus membros.
verses.en_web: The members of his body shall be devoured. The firstborn of death shall devour his members.
verses.en_bbe: His skin is wasted by disease, and his body is food for the worst of diseases.

verses.en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.pt: Arrancado da sua tenda, em que confiava, é levado ao rei dos terrores.
verses.en_web: He shall be rooted out of the security of his tent. He shall be brought to the king of terrors.
verses.en_bbe: He is pulled out of his tent where he was safe, and he is taken away to the king of fears.

verses.en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.pt: Na sua tenda habita o que não lhe pertence; espalha-se enxofre sobre a sua habitação.
verses.en_web: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur shall be scattered on his habitation.
verses.en_bbe: In his tent will be seen that which is not his, burning stone is dropped on his house.

verses.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.pt: Por baixo se secam as suas raízes, e por cima são cortados os seus ramos.
verses.en_web: His roots shall be dried up beneath. Above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.en_bbe: Under the earth his roots are dry, and over it his branch is cut off.

verses.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.pt: A sua memória perece da terra, e pelas praças não tem nome.
verses.en_web: His memory shall perish from the earth. He shall have no name in the street.
verses.en_bbe: His memory is gone from the earth, and in the open country there is no knowledge of his name.

verses.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.pt: É lançado da luz para as trevas, e afugentado do mundo.
verses.en_web: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.en_bbe: He is sent away from the light into the dark; he is forced out of the world.

verses.en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.pt: Não tem filho nem neto entre o seu povo, e descendente nenhum lhe ficará nas moradas.
verses.en_web: He shall have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
verses.en_bbe: He has no offspring or family among his people, and in his living-place there is no one of his name.

verses.en: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
verses.pt: Do seu dia pasmam os do ocidente, assim como os do oriente ficam sobressaltados de horror.
verses.en_web: Those who come after shall be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
verses.en_bbe: At his fate those of the west are shocked, and those of the east are overcome with fear.

verses.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
verses.pt: Tais são, na verdade, as moradas do, impio, e tal é o lugar daquele que não conhece a Deus.
verses.en_web: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
verses.en_bbe: Truly, these are the houses of the sinner, and this is the place of him who has no knowledge of God.
